claude_proposed_widenings.name: store_and_release_class_feature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Quivering Palm is structurally a two-phase feature: (1) plant vibrations on a Flurry of Blows hit while spending Focus Points, creating a persistent marked state on one creature; (2) later detonate with a separate activation cost, firing a save gate. ClassFeatureMechanics has only the 'activation' family — a single-phase activate → effect shape. There is no store→release family for class features. The closest analog in the spell space is anchored_trigger, but that family is not available under ClassFeatureMechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Flurry of Blows, you can expend 4 Focus Points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your Monk level. [...] when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of the attacks to end the vibrations.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: focus_point_resource (new variant of ClassFeatureResource)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The plant phase consumes 4 Focus Points — a pooled class resource with its own cap, reset cadence, and partial-refill rules (see Monk's Focus). UseCountResource with kind='use_count' models a per-feature charge count, not the shared Focus Point pool. A focus_point variant (or a general pooled_resource variant pointing to a named class pool) is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 4 Focus Points to start these imperceptible vibrations

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_flurry_hit (ClassFeatureActivationCost)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The plant activation is gated on landing a hit during Flurry of Blows — an attack-conditional trigger, not a free action or a bonus action. ClassFeatureActivationCost only supports 'free' | 'bonus_action'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Flurry of Blows, you can expend 4 Focus Points

claude_proposed_widenings.name: forgo_attack (ClassFeatureActivationCost)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The detonation can alternatively be triggered by giving up one attack from the Attack action — a cost type absent from ClassFeatureActivationCost. This is distinct from 'action' (which uses the whole action) and from 'bonus_action'. An 'action' variant would also be needed for the primary detonate path.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of the attacks to end the vibrations

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate_damage (ClassFeatureEffect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The detonation fires a Constitution saving throw dealing 10d12 Force damage on fail, half on success. ClassFeatureEffect only supports grant_extra_action and heal_hp. A damage-dealing save gate effect is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
